name: Do I need a building permit to replace countertops in the Tampa Bay area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit to replace countertops in the Tampa Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, replacing an existing countertop with identical dimensions does not require a municipal building permit, but structural changes or major utility relocations do. For example, if your countertop upgrade involves moving plumbing lines, reconfiguring gas connections for a cooktop, or altering load-bearing partition walls, local building departments in Brandon, Tampa, or surrounding Hillsborough County require permits. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms is fully insured, bonded, and carries workers' compensation, managing necessary trades and code requirements when kitchen or bathroom renovations include larger structural or mechanical alterations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple countertop swaps do not need permits, but permits are required if you move plumbing, relocate gas lines, or alter structural walls.
